evidence: Permit 100664740 was issued in 2016 for a new single-family house at 3416 N Bell. The assessor first reports the replacement building in 2018 with year built 2017, and the completed house sold in March 2018.

Permit 100710879 was issued in 2017 for a new single-family house at 3431 N Hoyne. The old building sold in June 2017, and the assessor first reports the replacement building in 2018 with year built 2018.

Permit 100475344 for a new three-story residential and commercial building at 1544 W North was completed with a certificate of occupancy in 2014. The later assessor record supplies the completed building fields but reports an implausible 2022 construction year.
Permit 100749057 was issued in 2018 for a three-unit building at 1841 N Sheffield. Multiple sale records identify the completed three-unit condominium building as built in 2019.

The 2017 permits at 3535 and 3541 S Maplewood authorize two groups of five townhouses. Sale records identify the completed townhouses as built in 2017; the assessor's earlier 2014 report predates the permits.
